description: This Java class defines a Fragment named PhotoFragment for Android applications. It manages photo display by loading images from URLs, handles user interactions such as clicks to broadcast zoom actions, and maintains state across configuration changes. It also includes methods for loading photos, handling lifecycle events, and setting photo URLs.

classes.name: PhotoFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a photo from a URL, supports click actions to zoom, and preserves state across lifecycle events.

methods.name: loadPhoto
methods.description: Converts the stored URL string to a URL object and attempts to download and display the image in PhotoView. Handles malformed URL exceptions.

methods.name: getURLString
methods.description: Returns the stored URL string used for loading the photo.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the photo view by broadcasting an intent to trigger zoom functionality.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes views, sets click listeners, and restores state if available.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view references to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Cleans up references when the fragment is detached from its activity.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current photo URL to the instance state bundle.

methods.name: setPhoto
methods.description: Sets the URL string for the photo to be displayed.
